verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a JavaScript bundle and a Tap-to-Phone SDK, plus an OpenAPI spec that could be used to generate client libraries, but there is no documentation of a broader set of official multi-language SDKs (e.g., Python, Ruby, Java) or a dedicated SDK reference/getting-started guide beyond these fragments. Missing for 10: comprehensive official SDK list across major languages, SDK versioning/release notes, and independent developer confirmation of SDK usage.
